audit_metadata.dataset: TempUN Full Clean (76 stages, 104,130 train NWP, 5,292 eval MCQA)

deficiency_1_relative_task_yes_no_collap.root_cause_analysis: Uncalibrated token logit prior: In Qwen2.5-3B vocab, token 'no' has an unconditional baseline logit consistently higher than token 'yes'. Taking argmax without marginal prior normalization forces 100% predictions to 'No'. The 37.91% accuracy exactly matches the sample proportion of 'No' in the dataset (323/852 = 37.91%), demonstrating zero actual temporal reasoning capability on binary comparative queries.
deficiency_1_relative_task_yes_no_collap.recommended_remediation: Apply marginal logit normalization: logit_calibrated(y) = logit(y) - logit_prior(y) or use balanced binary cross-entropy calibration prompt.

deficiency_2_option_letter_collapse_on_4.task_scope: Tasks DB, MM, RB, TB, WB (N = 4,440)
deficiency_2_option_letter_collapse_on_4.root_cause_analysis: Severe position/letter bias: Over 72% of samples achieve a debiased score of exactly 0.25 under 4-fold cyclic rotation (ABCD, BCDA, CDAB, DABC). This indicates that the model rigidly outputs a fixed letter position regardless of content rotation. When rotating 4 times, the target option lands on that fixed preferred position exactly 1 out of 4 times. As a result, the 28% canonical accuracy is mostly driven by letter bias (25% chance level + binary Yes/No artifact), while genuine robust temporal understanding (strict consistency) is only ~6.2%.
deficiency_2_option_letter_collapse_on_4.recommended_remediation: Incorporate contrastive option debiasing or multi-choice loss directly during post-training; evaluate using debiased mean accuracy rather than un-rotated canonical accuracy.
